messages:
Alex: quick mid-sprint check — calling out two items that need owner clarity and canary plans: kernel microburst patch (PR #4321) and KV eviction/tuning (PR #4330). @Mari / @Dan who will own rollout gating and perf signoff?
Alex: timeline goal is to canary this week if possible, otherwise we need a mitigation plan for next prod deploy.
Mari: kernel lead here. merged feature branch into staging yesterday but left the microbatching toggle off by default. perf tests show promising throughput gains. I can own the kernel rollout but need Dan for the canary wiring + smoke tests.
Dan: can do canary wiring. need infra flag + a quick smoke script for verifying KV correctness under small batch sizes. tagging @Kyle for the infra flag. ETA: I can have the canary in staging by end of day tomorrow if infra is ready.
Kyle: will add the feature flag in infra config. opening infra PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/278 — should be up for review in ~2h. will also add the routing policy key so traffic can be split 5/95.
Sara: ran a small benchmark on staging earlier, attaching quick notes. microburst reduces p95 for short sequences but p99 regressed ~8% on mixed-length traces. need to validate with longer KV-cached traces. snippet to reproduce:```bash
# small seq perf
wrk -t8 -c200 -d30s http://staging-redwood/api/generate -s scripts/microburst.lua
```
Sara: logs: link to gcs: gs://redwood-perf/microburst/run-2025-11-07-21.tar.gz — the tail shows some retry spikes around token 150 when eviction hit.
Dan: thanks, Sara. I suspect eviction race with the new prefetch path. I'll add extra metrics (kv.evictions, kv.eviction_latency_ms) and a short smoke that inserts a hot key loop to validate under concurrent load.
CI-bot: CI: build passed for PR #4321 (checks: unit, integration, perf-smoke).
Mari: plan for rollout: 1) infra flag on staging + canary traffic 5% (Dan) 2) monitor p95/p99, kv.evictions, error.rate for 2 hours (Sara + oncall) 3) if p99 > baseline by >5% rollback to old kernel.
Jen: oncall FYI — please update runbook section "microburst rollout" with rollback steps and target metric thresholds before canary. I'll be on standby during the window.
Alex: owner map and ETAs: Kernel rollout owner: Mari (PR #4321) — canary wiring: Dan (ETA staging by tomorrow EOD) — infra flag: Kyle (PR open) — perf validation: Sara (will run extended traces, ETA 24h) — oncall/runbook: Jen (update runbook).
Alex: blockers: 1) infra PR review + merge 2) perf extended runs to validate p99 3) confirm eviction telemetry is wired. If any of the three slip, we delay canary. callouts: @Mari please add the rollback flag and a short config snippet in the PR description.
Mari: added rollback guide in PR description and a short config YAML example.```yaml
feature_flag: microburst_kernel
rules:
  - id: canary
    percent: 5
    rollout: staged
```
Dan: I'll add the smoke test and metric dashboard links to the canary playbook. ping me for access to the staging routing key.
Kyle: infra PR updated with routing key, CI running. if CI passes I'll merge and flip the flag in staging.
Sara: starting extended perf run now (12h), will post results summary in this thread when done. expect first 2h summary ~ +2h.
Jen: noted. I'll set alert thresholds and create a temporary incident channel to watch during canary.
Alex: thanks all. action items summarized in PR comments and the sprint board. if anything unexpected pops up drop a quick message here and tag @Jen.
Alex: closing loop for now — will reconvene async after Sara's 2h summary.
